source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each round, every team member plays 1 opponent from the other team, and the team's combined scores decide the round.

As each round begins, the team captains run the pairing system for their team size to set who plays whom. Each pair then goes to its table. Each player finds the symbol of the opponent's Force Disposition on their own Force Disposition card and plays the Primary Mission listed under it, which sets how they score VP.

There are 3 pairing modules, chosen by team size:

- **3-player Teams:** Main Engagement.
- **4-player Teams:** Main Engagement, then Champion System.
- **5-player Teams:** Initial Skirmish, then Main Engagement.
- **6-player Teams:** Initial Skirmish, Main Engagement, then Champion System.
- **7-player Teams:** Initial Skirmish twice, then Main Engagement.
- **8-player Teams:** Initial Skirmish twice, Main Engagement, then Champion System.

detail.afterPairing: opposing players go to assigned tables
detail.identifyPrimaryScoring: look up the opponent’s Force Disposition on own card
